intent: One column per prompted step: which Google Cloud service it touched, which skill files it read, and that every step saved m1_stepN.txt, with the scorecard at Step 5.

six equal-width soft blue rounded cards in one row; in each card line 1 is 'Step N' alone in bold and the product name sits below it on one or two lines

regions.occupies: from 47% to 57% of the height, full width across all six columns
regions.contains: one wide light-grey pill with one line of monospace text
three light-grey monospace pills, one under column 3, one under column 5, one under column 6; columns 1, 2 and 4 are empty in this row

regions.occupies: from 74% to 83% of the height, full width across all six columns
regions.contains: one wide light-grey pill with one line of text

regions.occupies: from 85% to 94% of the height, under column 5 only
regions.contains: one light-grey pill as wide as column 5

text_exact.position: header card, column 1; line 1 is 'Step 1' alone in bold; 'Agent Registry' starts on line 2 and may wrap only between words; no middle dot
header card, column 2; line 1 is 'Step 2' alone in bold; 'IAM + BigQuery' starts on line 2 and may wrap only between words; no middle dot
header card, column 3; line 1 is 'Step 3' alone in bold; 'Agent Runtime + Cloud Run' starts on line 2 and may wrap only between words; no middle dot
header card, column 4; line 1 is 'Step 4' alone in bold; 'BigQuery access list' starts on line 2 and may wrap only between words; no middle dot
header card, column 5; line 1 is 'Step 5' alone in bold; 'Cloud Audit Logs' starts on line 2 and may wrap only between words; no middle dot
header card, column 6; line 1 is 'Step 7' alone in bold; 'Evidence files only' starts on line 2 and may wrap only between words; no middle dot
full-width grey bar, one line; 'm1_stepN.txt' in monospace

mandatory: Exactly six header cards of identical size in one row, all soft blue
The file pills sit exactly under columns 3, 5 and 6; nothing sits under columns 1, 2 and 4 in that row
'Scorecard' sits under column 5 only, below the saved bar

'SKILL.md + references/m1.md', 'm1-step3.md', 'm1-step5.md', 'showcase.md' and 'm1_stepN.txt' are monospace, each on one line, spelled exactly with lowercase letters, dots and hyphens kept; capital N in 'm1_stepN.txt'
The title reads exactly 'Six prompted steps, one skill', bold, top-left, one line
Every string in text_exact appears exactly once, spelled exactly as written
In every header card, 'Step N' is alone on line 1 in bold, and the product name starts on line 2; there is no middle dot anywhere in the image
The six header cards are tall (about 28% of the frame height) and the bars and pills are tall, so the rows fill the frame down to about 94% of its height
The title is bold near-black #1F2328, never grey
prohibitions: NO 'm1-step3.md' broken at its hyphen; NO 'm1_' at the end of one line with 'stepN.txt' on the next
NO row labels or headings other than the strings listed
NO command text, shell syntax, flags or flag values of any kind (no 'gcloud', 'curl', 'bq', 'agy -p', '--', '$', '|', 'stream-json')
NO URLs, hostnames or file paths other than the file names listed in text_exact
NO project IDs, project numbers, regions, or email addresses (nothing containing '@', 'projects/' or 'iam.gserviceaccount.com')
NO logos of any kind, including Google, Google Cloud, Gemini or Antigravity logos
NO people, faces, hands, silhouettes, robots, mascots or characters
NO text that is not listed in text_exact: no extra labels, numbers, step numbers, captions, legend, footnote or source note
NO identifier (file name or login name) broken across two lines
NO word broken at a hyphen
NO grey or faint text for any label; every label is semibold near-black #1F2328
source_refs: skills/novasmart-governance-lab/references/m1.md lines 8-11 (Step 3 reads m1-step3.md, Step 5 m1-step5.md, Step 7 showcase.md)

alt_text: Six prompted steps, one skill: six blue cards: Step 1, Agent Registry; Step 2, IAM + BigQuery; Step 3, Agent Runtime + Cloud Run; Step 4, BigQuery access list; Step 5, Cloud Audit Logs; Step 7, evidence files only. A bar across all six reads SKILL.md + references/m1.md. Extra files sit under three steps: m1-step3.md under Step 3, m1-step5.md under Step 5, showcase.md under Step 7. A second bar reads: Each step saves m1_stepN.txt. A Scorecard pill sits under Step 5.
